svg.text: Revised board · the installed main screen is the visual base; numbered marks describe the proposed changes.
INSTALLED MAIN SCREEN · FULL-SCREEN SOURCE CAPTURE
Pixel 3 XL capture · current layout reference · not post-change evidence
The left side stays the real screen composition. These close-ups specify placement and behavior.
Move the weather symbol, current temperature, feels-like value, and forecast description up 37 dp.
Keep current typography and icon sizes. Place feels-like immediately right of current temperature.
The two temperature values share a text baseline.
Precip, Wind, and Humidity keep their current order, labels, values, and sizes.
Keep the neutral glyph shown in the installed capture.
Arrow angle follows the supplied bearing; this symbol is illustrative and does not assert a specific bearing.
Transparent treatment, scene and sun/moon phase, location action and touch target, selected-time values,
source and unavailable-value behavior, timeline content, position, and interactions.
Compact portrait uses the same 37 dp / 20 dp relationships and retains existing responsive sizing.
HOW TO READ THE LEFT SCREEN
Gold arc crossed out = remove the halo.
Numbered overlays are design annotations, not installed UI. This board is proposed artwork, not acceptance evidence.
